resources.string: Turn on Ramadan mode? Sadiq will switch to Firm.
The ordinary schedule. Ramadan changes nothing.
Sadiq offers Ramadan mode and never switches it on by itself.
Bedtime starts 90 minutes after Isha and ends 40 minutes before Fajr, leaving Suhoor open.
The date is worked out on the phone from the Umm al-Qura calendar. Nothing is downloaded.
Think it over is on: this month a loosening change waits %1$d minutes.
On · loosening waits %1$d minutes this month
Off · a loosening change takes effect at once
